fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready: cycle close 2026-11-03
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-02 11:30 to 2026-11-03 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: no new escalations. Still unanswered:
- 21b6b4b7 (srs#236, P0): field identity and naming rules are in the spec but nothing enforces them. Options: enforce in the schema, enforce in a validator, or stop claiming them. Action needed: decide. Urgency: medium (the P0 cannot move). Waiting 4 days.
- 864eaebf (srs#991): one heading-outline rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition. You merged srs#991 on 11-02, so this draft needs your ruling recorded. Action needed: decide/ratify. Urgency: low.
- c7a8e0a2 (srs-rust#1497, already merged): may `note delete` refuse notes that Relations point at? Ratification only.
Also needs-input: srs-rust#1491, #683, srs#928.

2. Decided within mandate: nothing ratified. No builder-proposed decision was ready, so no session was held.

3. Done: 6 group PRs merged. Quorum lines (builder / reviewer / mandate):
- srs-rust#1487 package: refuse field/type updates that would invalidate records: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / RFC-039-R1 remedy 89d74184 (approve at b6301a8)
- srs-rust#1540 ErrorReport details typed union: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / decision 01cfb06e option d (approve at 33eac0d)
- srs-rust#1541 find `fields` option: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / owner ruling 1380, Door 1 (approve at 4a0ef38)
- srs-rust#1556 validate View/Composition checks: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / I-12, I-35 Door 1 (approve at 0bf5771)
- srs-rust#1557 lifecycle create runs update's checks: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / RFC-006 V9 Door 1 (approve at 5434290)
- srs#991 RFC-001 Revision 12 (Draft): owner-merge, reviewer verdict reject (Door 3 escalation); merged by you.
The five srs-rust merges came after your 11-02 direction to fix the rejected PRs.

4. Stuck or lost: 5 group-labelled PRs open (4 counted by group-state).
- srs-rust#1548 and #1551 (RFC-049 registry): reviewer rejected as an escalation (breaking change, stacked PRs).
- srs-rust#1549 and #1552: reviewer rejected, red CI (Schema Drift / Test).
- srs-rust#1535: gate:owner-merge, a reproduction test, no quorum line.
All reviewer findings lists are present for the merged PRs.

5. Budget: 5 of 10 delegated merges this cycle (srs#991 was owner-merge, not counted); 4 open. group-state for the new cycle: merged 0, open 4, room 6. Pause state: running.
5b. Awaiting ratification: c7a8e0a2, 864eaebf, 21b6b4b7 (drafts, above) and 8487fd7a (arrangement fixture allowlist, proposed since 10-27, 7 days). Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready + wg:third-party-ready in srs-rust, srs, srs-vscode, srs-web: 8 open issues (srs-rust 4, srs 2, srs-web 2, srs-vscode 0), all priority P2: srs-rust#1546, #1496, #1491, #1339 ; srs#931, #928 (RFC needed); srs-web#691, #632. Top 3 in builder order (no local priorities set, priority then oldest): srs-rust#1339, srs-rust#1491, srs-rust#1496. Open group PRs in flight: 5; budget left 6. Queue fed for about 1 cycle; it is running thin (8 ready, budget 10) and two of them need an RFC first. Needs feeding: the analyst, spec-to-implementation drift list, open exercises. Waits on you: the three decisions in 1 and the ratification in 5b. Fed by the analyst: 2026-10-23 (nominated 3, filed 1); no run since.
6b. Exercises (the group's own, none listed in the SemanticOps log): dd1a47a7 "Relation reads hide who asserted a link"; 2ac083c0 "One unknown key makes a whole repository unloadable"; 7131fe89 "Substrate entries: spec contract and schemas disagree". Build trigger: logs hold well over 10 ratified decisions, so srs-web#560 is still ready to unpark; your call.

7. What we learned: the group moved again once the pause lifted and you directed rework: five rejected PRs went green and merged in one night, which confirms the reviewer's red-gate rejections are specific enough to act on. Open: reviewer escalations (#1548, #1551, #991) stop at the Door 2/3 line as designed, but the drafts wait days for a ruling. Measurement 2a16eeb1 (I1): window opens at this close, so it reads 0 of 0 grounded; a close-time read is always near empty. Useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
fieldValues.rationale: No new escalations were raised this cycle: the three open escalation drafts (21b6b4b7, 864eaebf, c7a8e0a2) are unchanged and are listed again in section 1. The reviewer stopped #1548, #1551 and srs#991 at the Door 2/3 boundary, which is the designed behaviour.
fieldValues.figures: merged 5 of 10 delegated (+1 owner-merge); open 4 (group-state); running
